interpretation.property: a processed cross-chain message must be backed by a non-zero accepted root
interpretation.attack_prefix: zero-root initialization followed by three successful process/Receive transactions
interpretation.security_consequence: the three receipts transfer 100 WBTC each from the Nomad bridge path to attacker-controlled recipients
interpretation.btg_comparison_input: the same ordered four-transaction prefix manifest; XChainWatcher evaluates the three withdrawal-bearing suffix transactions
